reason: Identity check, per-customer caps, a human-approval queue and a kill switch in front of our own order path is a quarter of work for my team, and with a competitor already live we'd rather own that layer than rent it. I'd take the demo call to steal the checklist, not to sign.
objection: You want to sit inline in front of every agent trade and payment as a startup with no customers and no SOC 2. If you go down or get breached, my customers' orders stall or misfire, and I'm the one explaining a third-party proxy to FINRA.
would_change_my_mind: A comparable broker running it in production with a finished SOC 2 Type II, so I'm not the guinea pig and it beats what my team ships in a quarter.
